key_findings: Only safinamide (not rasagiline) alleviated hyperalgesia in MPTP mice, by reducing DRG neuron hyperexcitability and sodium current density.
Nav1.7 and Nav1.8 transcripts were upregulated in DRG neurons of MPTP mice.
